items.headline: U.S. Equities Rebound as Major Indices Close Higher, Driven by Strong Earnings
items.summary: U.S. stock markets closed higher on Wednesday, September 3, 2026, recovering some losses from previous sessions. All three major indices finished in positive territory, bolstered by robust earnings data. This upward movement occurred despite rising crude oil prices and increasing government bond yields, which usually pose inflationary concerns. Not financial advice.

items.summary: PG&E Corporation experienced a notable dip in its stock price.

items.summary: Cboe Global Markets, Inc. shares fell during Wednesday's trading session.

items.headline: Weak August Jobs Data Fuels Fed Rate Hike Expectations
items.summary: Private employers added only 38,000 jobs in August, the weakest count since January, yet market expectations for a September Federal Reserve rate hike rose to 61%. This follows the Fed maintaining rates at 3.5%-3.75% in July, with dissenting votes pushing for a September increase. The August Consumer Price Index (CPI) report is due September 10, with the next FOMC policy decision on September 15-16.

items.headline: Energy Leads, Technology and Consumer Discretionary Lagging Sectors
items.summary: The Energy Select Sector SPDR (XLE) was a leading performer, rising 1.3%. Conversely, several sectors saw declines, with the Consumer Discretionary Select Sector SPDR (XLY) falling 1.7%, Information Technology Select Sector SPDR (XLK) down 1.5%, Materials Select Sector SPDR (XLB) dropping 1.2%, and Industrials Select Sector SPDR (XLI) losing 1.4%.

items.headline: Dell Technologies Surges on Strong Earnings, G-III Apparel Group Misses Revenue Estimates
items.summary: Dell Technologies ($DELL) saw shares rise 15.8% after reporting strong quarterly adjusted earnings of $7.04 per share and revenues of $46.97 billion, both surpassing estimates. In contrast, G-III Apparel Group Ltd. ($GIII) plunged 11.5% after its second-quarter fiscal 2027 revenues missed expectations. Palo Alto Networks Inc. ($PANW) also fell 9.3% due to disappointing Subscription and Support revenues and adjusted gross profits. Ciena ($CIEN) is set to report its Q3 fiscal 2026 results before market open.

items.headline: Rising Oil Prices and Bond Yields Continue to Impact Markets
items.summary: Elevated crude oil prices, with WTI futures at $91.01 per barrel and Brent futures at $95.63 per barrel, are contributing to global inflationary concerns. The yield on the benchmark 10-Year U.S. Treasury Note reached 4.818%, its highest since November 2023. Geopolitical tensions, including the ongoing U.S.-Iran conflict, also remained a factor influencing market sentiment.

items.headline: Reshoring in Manufacturing Increases Amid Supply Chain Concerns
items.summary: Manufacturing companies increased their interest in reshoring operations in the first half of 2026, driven by logistics savings. A survey found 36% of OEMs were engaged in reshoring, up from 29% in 2025. However, challenges include workforce issues and rapid growth outpacing training infrastructure. Businesses also expressed concern about international conflict and shipping disruption impacting supply chains.
